newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes to resume Phoenix flights.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes to resume Phoenix flights.

text.p: Great Lakes Aviation Ltd said Wednesday it will resume service to Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport on Thursday, July 3.
In a release dated July 1, the airline said it will operate flights between Phoenix and both Show Low and Page/Lake Powell, Arizona.

The resumption of service follows a voluntary suspension May 16 of all Great Lakes operations. The airline has gradually resumed service as the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration completes inspections of the company's fleet, which operates as United Express and Great Lakes Airlines.
